predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Kortrijk vs Union St. Gilloise: Expected Goals (xG), Absences & Match Intelligence

Over 2.5 total goals is supported by a 2.91 combined lambda and Union's 80% away Over 2.5 rate, anchored on a 0:3 three-goal projection (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
